notes.title: NOTE OF UPDATE
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31534369/a878ba8aef7dbacaa0feac55fe32e1d6fce67a36.png

Dear players. The game received a major update on April 4, 2018, to better meet the expectations of buyers, attending requests and observations of users and friends. With that, the game became more beautiful, more intuitive and with better gameplay. The following are the main and most noticeable improvements.

• GAMEPAD: The game now supports the XBOX controller. Access "Controls" in the start menu or the "Start" menu, and press the "Start" or "B" button on the Controller to switch to GAMEPAD. This allowed a new experience with the game.
• GAME MENU and INTERFACE: The main menu and the "Start" menu have been fully repaginated giving the basic options: seeing achievements (stars), adjusting sounds; see game controls; and access to the tutorial. Intuitive character keys, buttons, and actions were added to the interface, shortening the way to the gameplay.
• GRAPHICS: Graphics of some objects and enemies have been redone using new and more appropriate graphics, making the game visually more modern and enjoyable.
• VIDEO: The game has received settings of automatic adjustment of the video, optimizing its visualization;
• Sounds: Some sounds and songs have been replaced, which made the game extremely enjoyable. New artists were included in the credits because of this.
• REDIRECT: When there are a small number of stones to be destroyed, the "Redirect" function will be activated automatically, which will allow the player to demonstrate his skills in redirecting the magical skulls to more effectively destroy these last stones, making the game more fun and very dynamic;
• FASES AND CHEFFES: After all the improvements, the game has been tested by some players. This enabled changes in the layout of the phases and mechanics of many of the game's actions, making it more practical and dynamic, but still meeting a difficulty level considered challenging and fair.
• TUTORIAL: The game will intervene during the gameplay four or five times to explain important commands to the player. These interventions, as well as the game's own tutorial, have been animated graphic displays that will give the player a clearer understanding of the game's commands with both the Keyboard and Mouse and the XBOX Controller.
• OTHERS: There are a number of other more technical improvements and corrections that should not be explained here but, along with the ones already mentioned, greatly revamp the game, making it more special.

I ask everyone to report possible errors or new observations about anything. I am always ready to listen to comments, criticisms and compliments.

From the developer: Vinicius Weiler Neves
